title: Unit 7 Test
subtitle: Question words · me / him / her / us / them · this / that · likes · shopping

sections.title: A. Complete the questions. Choose the correct question word.

items.q: ______ do you live? — In a flat near the park.
______ do you like him? — Because he’s funny.
______ is that boy? — He’s my cousin.
______ do you get to school? — By bus.

sections.title: B. Complete the sentences. Write me, him, her, it, us, or them.

items.q: I love my grandmother. I visit ______ every Sunday.
These are my new shoes. Do you like ______?
Where’s my phone? I can’t find ______.
Oybek is my best friend. I call ______ every day.

sections.title: C. Choose this, that, these, or those.

items.q: (in my hand) ______ is my new watch.
(over there) Look at ______ birds in the sky!

sections.title: D. Write the sentences. Use the -ing form.
E. Complete the conversation in a shop. Choose the correct answer.

items.q: A: It’s 80,000 so‘m. B: Can I ______ it on?

sections.title: F. Read the text and answer the questions.
sections.passage: My name’s Kamron. I’m 16. I live with my parents and my little sister, Soliha. I love sport. I play football three times a week, and on Saturdays I go swimming with my dad. I don’t like computer games, but my sister loves them! My favourite food is shashlik. My mum makes it for us on Sundays.

items.q: Who does he go swimming with?
